item.cyberfarm.harvester_module.desc: Harvests mature crops, melons and pumpkins, then replants.
item.cyberfarm.quarry_module.desc: Digs the surveyed area layer by layer, down to bedrock.
item.cyberfarm.quarry_module.cost: Per block: 20 FE + 10 FE per point of hardness
item.cyberfarm.transport_module.desc: Carries items from one container to another along the dock's route.
item.cyberfarm.planter_module.desc: Plants seeds from the dock on empty farmland in the work area.
item.cyberfarm.logger_module.desc: Fells whole trees in the work area, leaves included, and replants a sapling.
item.cyberfarm.logger_module.cost: Per log: 20 FE, per leaf block: 5 FE
item.cyberfarm.taxi_module.desc: Carries you, hanging from a hook, to the dock's taxi destination.
item.cyberfarm.rancher_module.desc: Shears sheep and any shearable mob, and milks cows and goats with buckets from the dock.
item.cyberfarm.fertilizer_module.desc: Grows crops and saplings with any fertilizer from the dock, bone meal or modded.
item.cyberfarm.stack_addon.desc: +1 stack (64 items) carried per Transport trip.
item.cyberfarm.fortune_addon.desc: Fortune for Quarry and Harvester drops, one level each.
item.cyberfarm.silk_touch_addon.desc: Silk Touch for Quarry and Harvester drops. Cannot be combined with Fortune.

cyberfarm.configuration.title: CyberFarm Configs
category.cyberfarm.drone_assembly.tier: Tier %s: %s module slots, up to %s addons
category.cyberfarm.note.per_item: %s s per item, no power needed
category.cyberfarm.note.capsule: Bring mobs in with a Mob Capsule
category.cyberfarm.note.heat: Up to %s mB/t of water to steam
info.block.cyberfarm.combustion_generato: Burns any furnace fuel into FE (40 FE/t) and pushes it into every adjacent machine or Energy Conduit.
info.block.cyberfarm.drone_assembler: Builds drones: put a frame, one to three function modules and optional addons, then press Assemble (2,000 FE). Put a finished drone back in the output slot to disassemble it.
info.block.cyberfarm.drone_dock: Home of one drone: charges it, stores its cargo and keeps its work area, transport route and item filter (Filter button in its GUI). Right-click it with a drone to deploy it.
info.block.cyberfarm.energy_conduit: Carries FE between generators and machines of any mod. Conduits connect by themselves and share power between all the machines they touch, up to 2,000 FE/t per source. Advanced: 16,000. Elite: 128,000. Right-click an arm touching a block to pull out of it (batteries, tanks, machines).
info.item.cyberfarm.drone: Right-click a Drone Dock to deploy it. Sneak + right-click the flying drone with an empty hand to pick it up again.
info.item.cyberfarm.survey_tool: Has four modes, switched with sneak + mouse wheel or a right-click in the air. Dock: right-click a Drone Dock to link it (sneak to reset it). Area: two opposite corners set the work area. Route: two containers set a transport route, another drone's dock too. Taxi: the block passengers land on. It never opens the blocks it clicks.
info.item.cyberfarm.harvester_module: The drone harvests mature crops, melons and pumpkins in its work area and replants them.
info.item.cyberfarm.quarry_module: The drone digs its surveyed area layer by layer down to bedrock, in order, and unloads every 192 items. Only keeps the drops the dock filter lets through. Never digs the default area around the dock.
info.item.cyberfarm.transport_module: The drone carries items from the source container to the destination container of its dock's route: 16 items per trip, plus one stack per Stack Addon. Only items the dock filter lets through are moved.
info.item.cyberfarm.planter_module: The drone loads seeds from its dock (wheat seeds, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, melon and pumpkin seeds, modded crops) and plants them on empty farmland in the work area. It never tills soil by itself.
info.item.cyberfarm.logger_module: The drone fells every tree in its work area from the top down, collecting logs, saplings and apples, then replants a sapling where the trunk stood. Player-placed leaves are left alone.
message.cyberfarm.taxi.no_destination: No destination: sneak + right-click a block with the Survey Tool
message.cyberfarm.taxi.low_energy: Not enough charge for the trip: needs %s FE
info.item.cyberfarm.taxi_module: The drone waits above its dock with a hook. Right-click it to grab the hook: it climbs above the terrain, flies to the dock's taxi destination and drops you off, then flies home. Set the destination by sneak + right-clicking a block with the Survey Tool. Sneak to let go: you get Slow Falling.
info.item.cyberfarm.rancher_module: The drone shears every shearable mob in its work area (sheep, mooshrooms, modded ones) and milks cows and goats with empty buckets it takes from the dock. Wool, milk buckets and the rest go back to the dock.
info.item.cyberfarm.fertilizer_module: The drone grows the crops, stems and saplings of its work area with fertilizer from the dock: bone meal or any fertilizer from other mods (tag c:fertilizers). Grass and moss are left alone.
gui.cyberfarm.muffler.machines.hint: CyberFarm machines: generators, the Drone Assembler, the Methane Extractor
gui.cyberfarm.muffler.drones.hint: Rotor hum, takeoff and landing of drones
gui.cyberfarm.muffler.animals.hint: Passive and neutral mobs: cows, chickens, villagers...
gui.cyberfarm.muffler.other_machines.hin: Sounds listed in the CyberFarm client config: by default furnaces, blast furnaces and smokers; add other mods' machines there
tooltip.cyberfarm.capsule.empty: Right-click a mob to capture it
tooltip.cyberfarm.capsule.release: Right-click a block to release, or a Methane Extractor to load its chamber
message.cyberfarm.extractor.incomplete: The extraction chamber is not complete
message.cyberfarm.extractor.occupied: There is already a mob in the chamber
message.cyberfarm.extractor.loaded: Mob placed in the extraction chamber
info.block.cyberfarm.gas_pipe: Carries gases (biogas, methane, Steam, any mod's gas) between tanks and machines of any mod; liquids need a Liquid Pipe. Pipes connect by themselves and share what enters between every block they touch, up to 1,000 mB/t per source. Advanced: 4,000. Elite: 16,000. Right-click an arm touching a block to pull out of it (batteries, tanks, machines).
info.block.cyberfarm.bio_digester: Turns organic waste (anything a composter takes, plus rotten flesh) into Biogas and pushes it into adjacent pipes and tanks. Needs no power.
info.block.cyberfarm.gas_turbine: Burns Biogas (3 FE/mB) or Methane (8 FE/mB) into FE, 20 mB per tick, and pushes the power into adjacent machines and conduits.
info.block.cyberfarm.methane_extractor: The top of a 3x3x4 chamber of Cyber Frame Blocks and glass. Put a mob inside with a Mob Capsule: zombies give 10 mB/t of Methane, other monsters 5, animals 2. Connect a Gas Pipe on top.
info.block.cyberfarm.cyber_frame: Sci-fi structural block used to build multiblocks, like the Methane Extractor chamber.
info.item.cyberfarm.mob_capsule: Right-click a mob to store it, then right-click a block to let it out, or a Methane Extractor to put it straight into its chamber. Released mobs never despawn. Bosses cannot be captured.
info.block.cyberfarm.muffler: Silences sounds within 10 blocks. Right-click it to choose what: CyberFarm machines, drones, monsters, animals and other sounds listed in the client config. Your own footsteps, doors and tools still make noise.
gui.cyberfarm.core.pylons.hint: This tier needs %s pylon columns, %s blocks tall, %s to %s blocks from the core, lined up on its sides with nothing between them and the crystal
gui.cyberfarm.core.pylon.details: Column %s blocks tall (needs %s), %s blocks away (%s to %s)
message.cyberfarm.pipe.normal: No longer pulling from this block
info.block.cyberfarm.liquid_tank: Stores 32 buckets of one liquid (water, lava, coolants, any mod's liquid). Fill it with Liquid Pipes or buckets; empty it with a bucket or a Liquid Pipe set to pull (right-click the pipe's arm). Right-click it to see what is inside.
info.block.cyberfarm.gas_tank: Stores 32,000 mB of one gas (biogas, methane, Steam, any mod's gas). Fill it with Gas Pipes; empty it with a Gas Pipe set to pull (right-click the pipe's arm). Right-click it to see what is inside.
message.cyberfarm.pump.no_water: Needs at least 2 water source blocks next to it
info.block.cyberfarm.reactor_controller: Heart of the Fission Reactor: a cooling tower of Reactor Casings and Ports in three sizes (Small 5x5x7, Medium 7x7x11, Large 9x9x15), with the controller in the middle of a side of the second layer. Bigger towers burn more rods (2, 4 or 8), reach more power and move more heat. Fuel Rods heat the core; water turns into Steam for Steam Turbines. Raise the power for more steam, but keep it cooled: Coolant and Cryo Coolant carry more heat. At 100% temperature it melts down. Right-click any block of the formed tower to open it.
info.block.cyberfarm.reactor_casing: Shell of the Fission Reactor tower. Lights up when the tower is complete.
info.block.cyberfarm.reactor_port: Part of the reactor shell that pipes and hoppers connect to: Fuel Rods and water go in, Depleted Fuel Rods and steam come out.
info.block.cyberfarm.resonance_core: Buildable FE storage. Alone it holds 1,000,000 FE; a complete shell of Resonance Cells around its crystal (3x3x3, 5x5x5, 7x7x7) raises it to tier 2, 3 and 4, up to 2,000,000,000 FE. Power goes in and out only through its Stabilizer Pylons.
info.block.cyberfarm.stabilizer_pylon: Stack them into columns in line with a Resonance Core on its sides: each tier needs more columns, taller and farther away. A linked column fires its beam at the crystal and is the core's way in and out: connect cables to any of its blocks.
info.block.cyberfarm.resonance_cell: Shell piece of a Resonance Core: build a complete cube of them around the crystal, empty inside, to raise the core by a tier. Once complete they vanish inside the bigger crystal.
info.block.cyberfarm.water_pump: Next to 2 or more water source blocks it pumps 500 mB/t of water with 40 FE/t and pushes it into adjacent pipes and machines.
info.item.cyberfarm.fuel_rod: Burns for 40 minutes in a Fission Reactor, then becomes a Depleted Fuel Rod.
gui.cyberfarm.reactor.temperature: Core %s °C — making %s heat/t, cooling up to %s/t, steam %s mB/t
info.block.cyberfarm.coolant_mixer: Makes reactor coolants with 20 FE/t: water + Lapis Lazuli → Coolant, Coolant + Blue Ice → Cryo Coolant, 500 mB per batch.
info.item.cyberfarm.biogas_bucket: Fill an empty bucket by right-clicking a machine or tank holding at least 1,000 mB of Biogas (e.g. a Bio-Digester or Gas Turbine). Right-click a machine, Reactor Port or tank to pour it back in. Gases are held upside down and cannot be poured into the world.
info.item.cyberfarm.methane_bucket: Fill an empty bucket by right-clicking a machine or tank holding at least 1,000 mB of Methane (e.g. a Methane Extractor or Gas Turbine). Right-click a machine, Reactor Port or tank to pour it back in. Gases are held upside down and cannot be poured into the world.
info.item.cyberfarm.steam_bucket: Fill an empty bucket by right-clicking a machine or tank holding at least 1,000 mB of Steam (e.g. a Fission Reactor port or Steam Turbine). Right-click a machine, Reactor Port or tank to pour it back in. Gases are held upside down and cannot be poured into the world.
info.item.cyberfarm.coolant_bucket: Fill an empty bucket by right-clicking a Coolant Mixer or tank holding at least 1,000 mB of Coolant, or scoop it from a pool. Right-click a machine, Reactor Port or tank to pour it in, or anywhere else to pour it into the world: whoever wades through it freezes, slowly.
info.item.cyberfarm.cryo_coolant_bucket: Fill an empty bucket by right-clicking a Coolant Mixer or tank holding at least 1,000 mB of Cryo Coolant, or scoop it from a pool. Right-click a machine, Reactor Port or tank to pour it in, or anywhere else to pour it into the world: whoever wades through it freezes much faster than in Coolant.
death.attack.cyberfarm.radiation.player: %1$s died of radiation sickness while fighting %2$s
tooltip.cyberfarm.depleted_fuel_rod: Radioactive! Contaminates the area around it
tooltip.cyberfarm.depleted_fuel_rod.hint: Treat it in a Waste Reprocessor
tooltip.cyberfarm.hazmat: Each piece keeps out 25% of radiation; the full suit, all of it
info.item.cyberfarm.depleted_fuel_rod: Nuclear waste. Carried, stored in a chest or any other mod's storage, or left on the ground it contaminates the chunk; enough contamination makes everything nearby sick and the land wither. Treat it in a Waste Reprocessor. A reactor with full waste slots leaks radiation.
info.block.cyberfarm.waste_reprocessor: Treats a Depleted Fuel Rod with 40 FE/t in 10 seconds: a harmless block of Vitrified Waste, and an Uranium Ingot one time in three. Waste inside it is shielded.
info.block.cyberfarm.vitrified_waste: Treated nuclear waste: inert glass, safe to store or to build with.
info.item.cyberfarm.hazmat_suit: Hazmat Suit: helmet, suit, pants and boots. Each piece keeps out a quarter of the radiation, the full suit all of it. It also keeps the cold of coolant pools out.
info.item.cyberfarm.geiger_counter: Hold it in either hand: it clicks faster where radiation is higher and shows the level in Rad above the hotbar. Sickness starts at 20 Rad, it gets serious at 100.
gui.cyberfarm.reactor.slot.unused: Not used by this tower size: build a bigger one
info.block.cyberfarm.turbine_controller: Heart of the Steam Turbine: a hall of Turbine Casings and Ports in three sizes (Small 3x3x4, Medium 5x5x6, Large 7x7x8), the controller in the middle of the front, the inside left empty for the rotor. Steam spins the rotor up; at full speed it uses 200, 600 or 1600 mB/t at 4, 5 or 6 FE per mB. Right-click any block of the formed turbine to open it.
info.block.cyberfarm.turbine_casing: Shell of the Steam Turbine hall. Lights up when the turbine is complete.
info.block.cyberfarm.turbine_port: Part of the turbine shell that pipes and cables connect to: steam goes in, FE comes out.
info.item.cyberfarm.multiblock_projector: Projects a multiblock as ghost blocks: what to place and where; wrong blocks show red. The structure stands on the block you aim at. Sneak + right-click to pick the structure, right-click a block to pin the projection (on a controller it lines up with it), right-click the air to unpin. In creative, right-click builds the structure instantly.
tooltip.cyberfarm.projector: Sneak + right-click: next structure. Right-click a block: pin (creative: build). Right-click air: unpin.
info.block.cyberfarm.liquid_pipe: Carries liquids (water, lava, Coolant, Cryo Coolant, any mod's liquid) between tanks and machines of any mod; gases need a Gas Pipe. Never joins a Gas Pipe line, so both can run side by side. Up to 1,000 mB/t per source. Advanced: 4,000. Elite: 16,000. Right-click an arm touching a block to pull out of it (batteries, tanks, machines).
info.block.cyberfarm.advanced_liquid_pip: Liquid Pipe for big flows: up to 4,000 mB/t per source. Joins the network of any Liquid Pipe tier.
info.block.cyberfarm.elite_liquid_pipe: Liquid Pipe for whole power plants: up to 16,000 mB/t per source. Joins the network of any Liquid Pipe tier.
info.block.cyberfarm.advanced_energy_con: Energy Conduit for big generators: up to 16,000 FE/t per source, enough for a Large Steam Turbine. Joins the network of any conduit tier.
info.block.cyberfarm.elite_energy_condui: Energy Conduit for power plants: up to 128,000 FE/t per source. Joins the network of any conduit tier.
info.block.cyberfarm.advanced_gas_pipe: Gas Pipe for big flows: up to 4,000 mB/t per source, enough for the steam of a Large reactor. Joins the network of any pipe tier.
info.block.cyberfarm.elite_gas_pipe: Gas Pipe for whole power plants: up to 16,000 mB/t per source. Joins the network of any pipe tier.
gui.cyberfarm.filter.whitelist.hint: Whitelist: only matching items pass. Blacklist: everything but matching items passes.
gui.cyberfarm.filter.components.hint: Exact: the item must also match enchantments, damage, names and other data. Any: only the item counts.
gui.cyberfarm.filter.mod.hint: By mod: any item from the same mod as a sample matches.
gui.cyberfarm.filter.tag.hint: Pick one of the tags of the first sample (e.g. #c:ingots): every item with that tag matches.
gui.cyberfarm.filter.slots.hint: Click with an item to add it as a sample (nothing is used up); click empty-handed to clear.
